arxiv-2104-02051.title: The 4d superconformal index near roots of unity and 3d Chern-Simons theory
arxiv-2104-02051.creator: Arash Arabi Ardehali and Sameer Murthy
arxiv-2104-02051.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Arash Arabi Ardehali and Sameer Murthy. We consider the S 3 × S 1 S^{3}\times S^{1} superconformal index ℐ ⁡ ( τ ) \mathcal{I}(\tau) of 4d 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 gauge theories. The Hamiltonian index is defined in a standard manner as the Witten index with a chemical potential τ \tau coupled to a combination of angular momenta on S 3 S^{3} and the U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) R-charge.

arxiv-2108-12201.title: A convergent finite volume scheme for the stochastic barotropic compressible Euler equations
arxiv-2108-12201.creator: Abhishek Chaudhary, Ujjwal Koley
arxiv-2108-12201.description: Abstract In this paper, we analyze a semi-discrete finite volume scheme for the three-dimensional barotropic compressible Euler equations driven by a multiplicative Brownian noise. We derive necessary a priori estimates for numerical approximations, and show that the Young measure generated by the numerical approximations converge to a dissipative measure–valued martingale solution to the stochastic compressible Euler system.

arxiv-2110-08252.title: A Rate-Distortion Framework for Explaining Black-box Model Decisions
arxiv-2110-08252.creator: Stefan Kolek, Duc Anh Nguyen, Ron Levie, Joan Bruna, Gitta Kutyniok
arxiv-2110-08252.description: Abstract We present the Rate-Distortion Explanation (RDE) framework, a mathematically well-founded method for explaining black-box model decisions. The framework is based on perturbations of the target input signal and applies to any differentiable pre-trained model such as neural networks. Our experiments demonstrate the framework’s adaptability to diverse data modalities, particularly images, audio, and physical simulations of urban environments.

arxiv-2111-08925.title: Higher order approximations to the longitudinal structure function F L F_{L} from the parametrization of F 2 F_{2} based on the Laplace transformation
arxiv-2111-08925.creator: G.R.Boroun, B.Rezaei
arxiv-2111-08925.description: Abstract We describe the determination of the longitudinal structure function F L F_{L} at NLO and NNLO approximations, using Laplace transform techniques, into the parametrization of F 2 ​ ( x , Q 2 ) F_{2}(x,Q^{2}) and its derivative with respect to ln ⁡ Q 2 \ln{Q^{2}} at low values of the Bjorken variable x x .

arxiv-2112-15124.title: Utilizing Wordnets for Cognate Detection among Indian Languages
arxiv-2112-15124.creator: Diptesh Kanojia, Kevin Patel, Pushpak Bhattacharyya, Malhar Kulkarni, Gholamreza Haffari
arxiv-2112-15124.description: Abstract Automatic Cognate Detection (ACD) is a challenging task which has been utilized to help NLP applications like Machine Translation, Information Retrieval and Computational Phylogenetics. Unidentified cognate pairs can pose a challenge to these applications and result in a degradation of performance.

arxiv-2408-01240.title: Tunable magnonic crystal in a hybrid superconductor–ferrimagnet nanostructure
arxiv-2408-01240.creator: Julia Kharlan 1,2 , Krzysztof Szulc 1,3 , Jarosław W. Kłos 1 , Grzegorz Centała 1
arxiv-2408-01240.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Julia Kharlan 1,2 , Krzysztof Szulc 1,3 , Jarosław W. Kłos 1 , Grzegorz Centała 1. One of the most intriguing properties of magnonic systems is their reconfigurability, where an external magnetic field alters the static magnetic configuration to influence magnetization dynamics. In this paper, we present an alternative approach to tunable magnonic systems. We studied theoretically and numerically a magnonic crystal induced within a uniform magnetic layer by a periodic magnetic field pattern created by the sequence of superconducting strips.

arxiv-2411-00102.title: High-velocity outflows persist up to 1 Gyr after a starburst in recently-quenched galaxies at z > z> 1
arxiv-2411-00102.creator: Elizabeth Taylor, David Maltby, Omar Almaini, Michael Merrifield, Vivienne Wild, Kate Rowlands, Jimi Harrold
arxiv-2411-00102.description: Abstract High-velocity outflows are ubiquitous in star-forming galaxies at cosmic noon, but are not as common in passive galaxies at the same epoch. Using optical spectra of galaxies selected from the UKIDSS Ultra Deep Survey (UDS) at z > 1 z>1 , we perform a stacking analysis to investigate the transition in outflow properties along a quenching time sequence.

arxiv-2504-06792.title: Domain Specific Pruning of Large Mixture-of-Experts Models with Few-shot Demonstrations
arxiv-2504-06792.creator: Zican Dong, Han Peng, Peiyu Liu, Wayne Xin Zhao, Dong Wu, Feng Xiao, Zhifeng Wang
arxiv-2504-06792.description: Abstract Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models achieve a favorable trade-off between performance and inference efficiency by activating only a subset of experts. However, the memory overhead of storing all experts remains a major limitation, especially in large-scale MoE models such as DeepSeek-R1 (671B).

arxiv-2505-03934.title: Exploring the Dynamics of General Relativistic Binary-Single and Binary-Binary Encounters of Black Holes
arxiv-2505-03934.creator: Felix M. Heinze 1, Bernd Brügmann 1, Tim Dietrich 2,3, Ivan Markin 3
arxiv-2505-03934.description: Abstract In this exploratory study, we demonstrate the capability of the numerical-relativity code BAM to simulate fully relativistic black-hole binary-single and binary-binary encounters. While previous work has demonstrated the general capability of numerical-relativity frameworks to evolve spacetimes with N N black holes, detailed explorations of such encounters remain limited.

arxiv-2509-02029.title: Fake & Square: Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Synthetic Data and Synthetic Hard Negatives
arxiv-2509-02029.creator: Nikolaos Giakoumoglou, Andreas Floros, Kleanthis Marios Papadopoulos, Tania Stathaki
arxiv-2509-02029.description: Abstract This paper does not introduce a new method per se. Instead, we build on existing self-supervised learning approaches for vision, drawing inspiration from the adage ”fake it till you make it”. While contrastive self-supervised learning has achieved remarkable success, it typically relies on vast amounts of real-world data and carefully curated hard negatives.

arxiv-2510-13959.title: Strong Evidence for Cosmic Ray-Supported ∼ \sim L ∗ Galaxy Halos via X-ray & tSZ Constraints
arxiv-2510-13959.creator: Sam B. Ponnada, Philip F. Hopkins, Yue Samuel Lu, Emily M. Silich, Iryna S. Butsky, Dušan Kereš
arxiv-2510-13959.description: Abstract Many state-of-the-art galaxy simulations featuring traditional feedback modes have significant challenges producing enough extended soft X-ray ( ∼ 0.5 − 2 \sim 0.5-2 keV) emission at R ∼ 0.5 − 1 \sim 0.5-1 R vir observed around galaxies with stellar masses M ∗ ≲ 10 11 M ⊙ {}_{\rm\ast}\lesssim 10^{11}\rm M_{\odot} , without violating galaxy mass function constraints.

arxiv-2510-26209.title: Multi-Faceted Emission Properties of PSR J2129+4119 Observed with FAST DSPSR ( W. van Straten & M. Bailes 2011 ) , PSRCHIVE ( A. W. Hotan et al. 2004 ) , TEMPO2 ( G. B. Hobbs et al. 2006 ) , PSRSALSA ( P. Weltevrede 2016 )
arxiv-2510-26209.creator: H. M. Tedila, D. Li, P. Wang, R. Yuen, Z. W. Wu, S. J. Dang, J. P. Yuan, N. Wang, M. Cruces, J. S. Zhang, J. Bai, D. Zhao
arxiv-2510-26209.description: Abstract We present a detailed single-pulse study of the long-period pulsar PSR J2129+4119 using high-sensitivity FAST observations. Despite locating well below the traditional death line, the pulsar exhibits sustained and multi-modal emission behavior, including nulls, weak pulses, regular emission, and occasional bright pulses. The nulling fraction is measured to be 8.13 % ± 0.51 % 8.13\%\pm 0.

arxiv-2512-08944.title: Enhancing Reliability across Short and Long-Form QA via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2512-08944.creator: Yudong Wang †‡∗ Zhe Yang † Wenhan Ma †‡ Zhifang Sui †⋄ Liang Zhao ‡ † State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing, School of Computer Science, Peking University ‡ LLM-Core Xiaomi
arxiv-2512-08944.description: Abstract While reinforcement learning has unlocked unprecedented complex reasoning in large language models, it has also amplified their propensity for hallucination, creating a critical trade-off between capability and reliability. This work confronts this challenge by introducing a targeted RL framework designed to mitigate both intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations across short and long-form question answering.

arxiv-2601-22370.title: Operator Splitting with Hamilton-Jacobi-based Proximals
arxiv-2601-22370.creator: Nicholas Di, Eric C. Chi, Samy Wu Fung
arxiv-2601-22370.description: Abstract Operator splitting algorithms are a cornerstone of modern first-order optimization, decomposing complex problems into simpler subproblems solved via proximal operators. However, most functions lack closed-form proximal operators, which has long restricted these methods to a narrow set of problems.

pmc-10560358.title: Minimal invasive approaches for pediatric & congenital heart surgery: safe, reproducible, more cosmetic than through sternotomy, and here to stay
pmc-10560358.creator: Jannika Dodge-Khatami, Ali Dodge-Khatami, Thai Duy Nguyen, André Rüffer
pmc-10560358.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Minimal invasive approaches through small thoracic incisions for the isolated repair of the most common congenital heart defects have been around for decades. However, the lack of belonging in established surgical training curriculums compared to the traditional median sternotomy, the requirement for more technical expertise and a certain learning curve, has limited their use, being routinely performed only by certain surgeons in specialized centers.

pmc-10590946.title: Evaluating screw-shaft pile composite foundations in round Gravelly soil: A study using model tests and numerical simulations
pmc-10590946.creator: Tingting Yang, Weicheng Zheng, Yongli Xie, Hongguang Zhang, Xiabing Yue
pmc-10590946.description: Screw-shaft piles have seen extensive adoption in construction and railroad engineering, due to their superior enhanced bearing capacity and cost-effectiveness. While monopiles have been thoroughly examined, composite foundations that include screw-shaft piles have not been studied as extensively. Proper determination of geometric parameters for both the piles and the cushion is a critical aspect of successful design.

pmc-10603275.title: The impact of free antiretroviral therapy for pregnant non‐citizens and their infants in Botswana
pmc-10603275.creator: Christina Fennell, Daniel Escudero, Rebecca Zash, Modiegi Diseko, Gloria Mayondi, Judith Mabuta, Tumalano Sekoto, Tendani Gaolathe, Mompati Mmalane, Shahin Lockman, Joseph Makhema, Roger Shapiro
pmc-10603275.description: IntroductionIn December 2019, the Botswana government expanded free antiretroviral therapy (ART) to include non‐citizens. We evaluated the impact of this policy change on antenatal care (ANC), antiretroviral therapy coverage and adverse birth outcomes.MethodsThe Tsepamo Surveillance study collects data at up to 18 delivery sites in Botswana.

pmc-10650802.title: Artificial Intelligence Methods for the Construction and Management of Buildings
pmc-10650802.creator: Svetlana Ivanova, Aleksandr Kuznetsov, Roman Zverev, Artem Rada, Vincent Gan, Mingzhu Wang, Weiwei Chen, Ali Ghahramani
pmc-10650802.description: Artificial intelligence covers a variety of methods and disciplines including vision, perception, speech and dialogue, decision making and planning, problem solving, robotics and other applications in which self-learning is possible. The aim of this work was to study the possibilities of using AI algorithms at various stages of construction to ensure the safety of the process.

pmc-11602040.title: Defining a good death: Perspectives of patients, relatives, and health care professionals in the Catalan context—A qualitative study
pmc-11602040.creator: Vicky Serra-Sutton, Lluïsa Fernández-Giner, Mireia Espallargues, Anna García-Altès, in name of the Good death study in Catalonia, Martin Mbonye, Martin Mbonye, Martin Mbonye, Martin Mbonye, Martin Mbonye
pmc-11602040.description: Health systems often lack integrated, person-centered end-of-life care. Improving this care is a key priority for decision-makers in the Catalan context. This study aimed to understand how key stakeholders in the healthcare sector—patients, family members, and healthcare professionals—define the concept of a ’good death’ and identify their key common elements in Catalonia, Spain.

pmc-11714633.title: Correlates of missed or late versus timely diagnosis of dementia in healthcare settings
pmc-11714633.creator: Yi Chen, Melinda Power, Francine Grodstein, Ana W Capuano, Brittney S Lange‐Maia, Ali Moghtaderi, Emma K Stapp, Joya Bhattacharyya, Raj C Shah, Lisa L Barnes, David A Bennett, Bryan D James
pmc-11714633.description: BackgroundPrevious research suggests dementia is undetected in healthcare settings for more than half of those with dementia. Most research on underdiagnosis of dementia has focused on the presence or absence of a clinical diagnosis in claims or the medical record without addressing differences in the timeliness of a diagnosis.

pmc-11715461.title: Assessing the correlations between imaging and plasma biomarkers within the AT(N) framework
pmc-11715461.creator: Alexandra Gogola, Ann D Cohen, Xuemei Zeng, Brian J Lopresti, Beth E Snitz, Dana Tudorascu, Davneet S Minhas, Milos D Ikonomovic, Tharick A Pascoal, Julia Kofler, Cristy Matan, Neale S Mason, Howard J Aizenstein, Chester Mathis, William E Klunk, Henrik Zetterberg, Kaj Blennow, Oscar L Lopez, Victor
pmc-11715461.description: BackgroundGiven the increasing usage of plasma biomarkers for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) studies, it is necessary to better understand relationships between plasma biomarker and PET and MR imaging outcomes, particularly within the AT(N) framework.MethodWe evaluated plasma samples from 233 subjects (age 74.05.9y) who underwent 3T MR and both [11C]PiB and [18F]flortaucipir (FTP) PET imaging.

pmc-12513343.title: Impact of Solid Fuel Use on Household Air Pollution and Respiratory Health in Two Low-Income Communities in Mpumalanga, South Africa
pmc-12513343.creator: Bianca Wernecke, Kristy Langerman, Angela Mathee, Nada Abdelatif, Marcus A. Howard, Nkosana Jafta, Christiaan Pauw, Shumani Phaswana, Kareshma Asharam, Ishen Seocharan, Hendrik Smith, Rajen N. Naidoo, Natasha Naidoo, Caradee Y. Wright
pmc-12513343.description: Introduction: Household air pollution from domestic solid fuel use remains a global public health concern, particularly in low-income communities. This study assessed associations between household fuel use, indoor air pollution, and respiratory health outcomes in two Mpumalanga communities in South Africa.Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted in KwaZamokuhle and eMzinoni between July 2019 and February 2020.

pmc-12764215.title: The eNAMPT-Integrin α5β1 Axis Mediates Neutrophil-Endothelial Cell Interactions Driving Inflammation in Ulcerative Colitis
pmc-12764215.creator: Yongcheng Di, Wenbin Ji, Wenhao Xiong, Wenbin Song, Guoshan Chen, Danzhou Li, Feng Qi
pmc-12764215.description: BackgroundUlcerative colitis (UC), a chronic inflammatory bowel disease with rising global incidence, involves neutrophil-driven mucosal damage. The precise mechanisms remain elusive, hindering targeted therapies. Therefore, this study aims to integrate single-cell transcriptomics with in vivo experiments to reveal the key signaling axes driving pathogenic neutrophil activation in UC.

pmc-13147343.title: Capnocytophaga canimorsus Septicaemia Presenting With Multiorgan Dysfunction Syndrome (MODS) and Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC) in an Immunocompetent Individual
pmc-13147343.creator: Kadison Michel, Prashant Pruthi, Charlie Corke, Lipi Buch
pmc-13147343.description: We present a rare case of fulminant Capnocytophaga canimorsus septicaemia in a previously well 52‐year‐old immunocompetent woman, following a minor dog‐related forehead abrasion. Despite a recent course of amoxicillin/clavulanate prescribed by her general practitioner, the patient developed profound sepsis characterised by disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), multiorgan dysfunction syndrome (MODS) and severe metabolic derangements.

pmc-13416463.title: Association of plasma homocysteine with the atherogenic index of plasma and modification by body mass index: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13416463.creator: Bin Jiang, Juan Yu, Chongxiang Chen, Yongshi Huang
pmc-13416463.description: ObjectiveHyperhomocysteinemia is generally considered an independent risk factor for cardiovascular disease; nevertheless, the independent connection between plasma homocysteine (HCY) and the atherogenic index of plasma (AIP), which integrates the risk of atherogenic lipids, has not been completely elucidated. pmc-13678652.creator: Aida Romano-Martinez, Silav Zeid, Mykhailo Krolevets, Konstantin Kontohow-Beckers, Vincent ten Cate, Philipp Lurz, Sandy Engelhardt, Stefan Kramer, Sven-Oliver Troebs, Philipp S Wild
